package lifecycle_test

import (
	lifecycle "example.com/compilerprofile/generated"
	"reflect"
	"testing"
)

func ptr(s string) *string { return &s }
func snapshot(t lifecycle.Task) lifecycle.Task {
	c := t
	if t.Owner != nil {
		c.Owner = ptr(*t.Owner)
	}
	if t.Acceptance != nil {
		c.Acceptance = append([]string{}, t.Acceptance...)
	}
	return c
}
func verify(t *testing.T, input lifecycle.Task, command lifecycle.Command, want lifecycle.Result) {
	t.Helper()
	before := snapshot(input)
	commandBefore := command
	if command.Review != nil {
		r := *command.Review
		commandBefore.Review = &r
	}
	got := lifecycle.Transition(input, command)
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {
		t.Fatalf("PROFILE_ORACLE_MISMATCH complete result mismatch\ngot: %#v task=%#v\nwant: %#v task=%#v", got, got.Task, want, want.Task)
	}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(input, before) || !reflect.DeepEqual(command, commandBefore) {
		t.Fatal("PROFILE_ORACLE_MISMATCH input mutation")
	}
	if got.Task != nil {
		if input.Owner != nil && got.Task.Owner == input.Owner {
			t.Fatal("PROFILE_ORACLE_MISMATCH owner aliases input")
		}
		if got.Task.Owner != nil {
			*got.Task.Owner = "changed-output"
		}
		if len(got.Task.Acceptance) > 0 {
			got.Task.Acceptance[0] = "changed-output"
		}
		if !reflect.DeepEqual(input, before) {
			t.Fatal("PROFILE_ORACLE_MISMATCH output aliases input storage")
		}
		if input.Owner != nil {
			*input.Owner = "changed-input"
			if got.Task.Owner != nil && *got.Task.Owner == "changed-input" {
				t.Fatal("PROFILE_ORACLE_MISMATCH input aliases output owner")
			}
		}
		if len(input.Acceptance) > 0 {
			input.Acceptance[0] = "changed-input"
			if got.Task.Acceptance[0] == "changed-input" {
				t.Fatal("PROFILE_ORACLE_MISMATCH input aliases output acceptance")
			}
		}
	}
}

func TestProfileOptionalStrings(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("ownerAbsent_nil", func(t *testing.T) {
		verify(t, lifecycle.Task{ID: "sample", State: "Open", Revision: 0, Outcome: "", Acceptance: []string{}, Owner: nil}, lifecycle.Command{Type: "ownerAbsent", Actor: "", ExpectedRevision: 0, Review: nil}, lifecycle.Result{Mode: "example-only", Authority: "none", ModelDigest: "c93f00645c2e8fcf763d65f294df8f742d024bb519fc0851a9e7320df04253e3", OK: true, TransitionID: "T_ownerAbsent", Task: &lifecycle.Task{ID: "sample", State: "Closed", Revision: 1, Outcome: "", Acceptance: []string{}, Owner: nil}, Refusals: []string{}})
	})
	t.Run("ownerAbsent_empty", func(t *testing.T) {
		verify(t, lifecycle.Task{ID: "sample", State: "Open", Revision: 0, Outcome: "", Acceptance: []string{}, Owner: ptr("")}, lifecycle.Command{Type: "ownerAbsent", Actor: "", ExpectedRevision: 0, Review: nil}, lifecycle.Result{Mode: "example-only", Authority: "none", ModelDigest: "c93f00645c2e8fcf763d65f294df8f742d024bb519fc0851a9e7320df04253e3", OK: false, TransitionID: "T_ownerAbsent", Task: &lifecycle.Task{ID: "sample", State: "Open", Revision: 0, Outcome: "", Acceptance: []string{}, Owner: ptr("")}, Refusals: []string{"G_ownerAbsent"}})
	})
	t.Run("ownerAbsent_unicode_space", func(t *testing.T) {
		verify(t, lifecycle.Task{ID: "sample", State: "Open", Revision: 0, Outcome: "", Acceptance: []string{}, Owner: ptr("  ")}, lifecycle.Command{Type: "ownerAbsent", Actor: "", ExpectedRevision: 0, Review: nil}, lifecycle.Result{Mode: "example-only", Authority: "none", ModelDigest: "c93f00645c2e8fcf763d65f294df8f742d024bb519fc0851a9e7320df04253e3", OK: false, TransitionID: "T_ownerAbsent", Task: &lifecycle.Task{ID: "sample", State: "Open", Revision: 0, Outcome: "", Acceptance: []string{}, Owner: ptr("  ")}, Refusals: []string{"G_ownerAbsent"}})

func TestProfileListPresence(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("nil_list", func(t *testing.T) {
		verify(t, lifecycle.Task{ID: "sample", State: "Open", Revision: 0, Outcome: "", Acceptance: nil, Owner: nil}, lifecycle.Command{Type: "criteria", Actor: "", ExpectedRevision: 0, Review: nil}, lifecycle.Result{Mode: "example-only", Authority: "none", ModelDigest: "c93f00645c2e8fcf763d65f294df8f742d024bb519fc0851a9e7320df04253e3", OK: false, TransitionID: "T_criteria", Task: &lifecycle.Task{ID: "sample", State: "Open", Revision: 0, Outcome: "", Acceptance: nil, Owner: nil}, Refusals: []string{"G_criteria"}})
	})
	t.Run("empty_list", func(t *testing.T) {
		verify(t, lifecycle.Task{ID: "sample", State: "Open", Revision: 0, Outcome: "", Acceptance: []string{}, Owner: nil}, lifecycle.Command{Type: "criteria", Actor: "", ExpectedRevision: 0, Review: nil}, lifecycle.Result{Mode: "example-only", Authority: "none", ModelDigest: "c93f00645c2e8fcf763d65f294df8f742d024bb519fc0851a9e7320df04253e3", OK: false, TransitionID: "T_criteria", Task: &lifecycle.Task{ID: "sample", State: "Open", Revision: 0, Outcome: "", Acceptance: []string{}, Owner: nil}, Refusals: []string{"G_criteria"}})
	})
	t.Run("one_item", func(t *testing.T) {
		verify(t, lifecycle.Task{ID: "sample", State: "Open", Revision: 0, Outcome: "", Acceptance: []string{"criterion"}, Owner: ptr("keeper")}, lifecycle.Command{Type: "criteria", Actor: "", ExpectedRevision: 0, Review: nil}, lifecycle.Result{Mode: "example-only", Authority: "none", ModelDigest: "c93f00645c2e8fcf763d65f294df8f742d024bb519fc0851a9e7320df04253e3", OK: true, TransitionID: "T_criteria", Task: &lifecycle.Task{ID: "sample", State: "Closed", Revision: 1, Outcome: "", Acceptance: []string{"criterion"}, Owner: ptr("keeper")}, Refusals: []string{}})
	})
	t.Run("blank_item_is_invalid_not_guard_false", func(t *testing.T) {
		verify(t, lifecycle.Task{ID: "sample", State: "Open", Revision: 0, Outcome: "", Acceptance: []string{" "}, Owner: nil}, lifecycle.Command{Type: "criteria", Actor: "", ExpectedRevision: 0, Review: nil}, lifecycle.Result{Mode: "example-only", Authority: "none", ModelDigest: "c93f00645c2e8fcf763d65f294df8f742d024bb519fc0851a9e7320df04253e3", OK: false, TransitionID: "", Task: nil, Refusals: []string{"INVALID_INPUT"}})
	})
}

		verify(t, lifecycle.Task{ID: "sample", State: "Open", Revision: 0, Outcome: "", Acceptance: []string{"criterion"}, Owner: ptr("keeper")}, lifecycle.Command{Type: "nested", Actor: "keeper", ExpectedRevision: 0, Review: nil}, lifecycle.Result{Mode: "example-only", Authority: "none", ModelDigest: "c93f00645c2e8fcf763d65f294df8f742d024bb519fc0851a9e7320df04253e3", OK: true, TransitionID: "T_nested", Task: &lifecycle.Task{ID: "sample", State: "Closed", Revision: 1, Outcome: "", Acceptance: []string{"criterion"}, Owner: ptr("keeper")}, Refusals: []string{}})
	})
	t.Run("nested_different_and_list", func(t *testing.T) {
		verify(t, lifecycle.Task{ID: "sample", State: "Open", Revision: 0, Outcome: "", Acceptance: []string{"criterion"}, Owner: ptr("keeper")}, lifecycle.Command{Type: "nested", Actor: "other", ExpectedRevision: 0, Review: nil}, lifecycle.Result{Mode: "example-only", Authority: "none", ModelDigest: "c93f00645c2e8fcf763d65f294df8f742d024bb519fc0851a9e7320df04253e3", OK: false, TransitionID: "T_nested", Task: &lifecycle.Task{ID: "sample", State: "Open", Revision: 0, Outcome: "", Acceptance: []string{"criterion"}, Owner: ptr("keeper")}, Refusals: []string{"G_nested"}})
	})
	t.Run("nested_absent_nil", func(t *testing.T) {
		verify(t, lifecycle.Task{ID: "sample", State: "Open", Revision: 0, Outcome: "", Acceptance: nil, Owner: nil}, lifecycle.Command{Type: "nested", Actor: "", ExpectedRevision: 0, Review: nil}, lifecycle.Result{Mode: "example-only", Authority: "none", ModelDigest: "c93f00645c2e8fcf763d65f294df8f742d024bb519fc0851a9e7320df04253e3", OK: false, TransitionID: "T_nested", Task: &lifecycle.Task{ID: "sample", State: "Open", Revision: 0, Outcome: "", Acceptance: nil, Owner: nil}, Refusals: []string{"G_nested"}})
	})
	t.Run("nested_matching_empty", func(t *testing.T) {
		verify(t, lifecycle.Task{ID: "sample", State: "Open", Revision: 0, Outcome: "", Acceptance: []string{}, Owner: ptr("keeper")}, lifecycle.Command{Type: "nested", Actor: "keeper", ExpectedRevision: 0, Review: nil}, lifecycle.Result{Mode: "example-only", Authority: "none", ModelDigest: "c93f00645c2e8fcf763d65f294df8f742d024bb519fc0851a9e7320df04253e3", OK: false, TransitionID: "T_nested", Task: &lifecycle.Task{ID: "sample", State: "Open", Revision: 0, Outcome: "", Acceptance: []string{}, Owner: ptr("keeper")}, Refusals: []string{"G_nested"}})
	})
	t.Run("nested_present_empty_matches", func(t *testing.T) {
		verify(t, lifecycle.Task{ID: "sample", State: "Open", Revision: 0, Outcome: "", Acceptance: []string{"criterion"}, Owner: ptr("")}, lifecycle.Command{Type: "nested", Actor: "", ExpectedRevision: 0, Review: nil}, lifecycle.Result{Mode: "example-only", Authority: "none", ModelDigest: "c93f00645c2e8fcf763d65f294df8f742d024bb519fc0851a9e7320df04253e3", OK: true, TransitionID: "T_nested", Task: &lifecycle.Task{ID: "sample", State: "Closed", Revision: 1, Outcome: "", Acceptance: []string{"criterion"}, Owner: ptr("")}, Refusals: []string{}})
	})
}
